notes.title: Downfall is updated to version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hi there! Thanks for buying and playing Downfall in recent times. We've gone ahead with a much needed update that improves graphics and memory settings via winsetup (right click Downfall in your Libary list and select Setup).

[b][u]Save games from earlier versions are not compatible. Sorry about that. You'll need to right click on Downfall in Library, then Settings, then Betas and then select the "Agnes" branch to return to version 1.1.2 and continue any previously saved games. Please see the technical note below.[/u][/b]

New players: There is nothing to worry about, just start a new game with version 1.1.3!

You may need to adjust these settings slightly to suit your needs. Press Advanced for additional options.

Version 1.1.3 has been rebuilt through the latest version of AGS which allows for better graphics options for HD resolution systems

ːcatbloodː Alt+Enter to switch between Fullscreen & Windowed Mode whilst playing, 

ːcatbloodː Increased memory cache, was max 100mb now max 512mb, which should help those who experience slowdown issues

ːcatbloodː Updated steam_api.dll for those who have experienced an error on startup with "SetAchievement^1" error

Technical note: They say lightning doesn't strike the same place twice but the problem with save games is exactly the same as the recent Cat Lady update. A certain int (stored data) within the game now conflicts with a new command inside the AGS engine, so when the game tries to check this data (when loading a game) it can't do it. It is pure co-incidence that Rem used the same line of code twice (in both games) which now leads to a conflict. We will continue to look into a workaround but have not found one yet.

In the meantime, you will need to switch to the Agnes branch (version 1.1.2) to continue any previously started game. We apologize for the inconvenience, but think it's best players can enjoy the game with more settings options than before.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11803826/5266c6a0219e5a4887b99609d62aff83f279100b.jpg[/img]

Agnes

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11803826/c4c9a5e8d9422bf400b1a025399d2767acdff1c8.jpg[/img]

Branch

Regards, Screen 7
and on behalf of Harvester Games

notes.title: Update to ver 1.1.2 - Spanish translation
notes.notes:
Downfall will now update to v1.1.2 which includes Spanish text translation. The update is about 2.5mb.

Save games from the last versions are compatible, however it's advised that you start a new game to use these (or any) translations.

You may need to adjust the Settings (Graphic Filter, side borders etc) via setup again as they may have reverted to their defaults since the update.

Thanks to Ignacio Parentella for writing the translation and to the community for their patience. We hope you enjoy the update.

Note: Linux version is still accessible but we cannot provide full Linux support at present. We are reviewing the situation across our entire catalogue and will post a full announcement about this soon.

regards!

notes.title: Have You Played The Cat Lady?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

I haven’t played The Cat Lady [official site]. Or at least, I haven’t played it to completion. If I had to answer my own question, ‘have you played The Cat Lady?’, I’d have to say no, because what little of it I saw, I now believe I misread or was in the wrong mood to appreciate. Time to give it a second chance.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 - French & German translations added
notes.notes:
Downfall will now update automatically to version 1.1.1 which includes 2 new fan made translations!

[b]French[/b] thanks to Jugdjay and
[b]German[/b] thanks to HeavenSmile

[b](New: 1st Sept, If you notice an additional 195mb download - that is the old game being re-installed. Our apologies, it had been accidentally excluded in the original 1.1.1 update)[/b]

Save games from the last version are compatible, however it's advised that you start a new game to use these (or any) translations. 

You may need to adjust the Settings (Graphic Filter, side borders etc) via setup again as they may have reverted to their defaults since the update.

Don't forget there is also Italian, Russian and Brazil Portuguese available. Language can be selected after the initial company logo.

Thank you for playing, purchasing the game in the Steam summer sale and to those who have helped write translations to allow international players the chance to experience Downfall :)

Please note, just in case we find any small remaining issues, you may notice another very small update in the next few days. But this is normal and your game and saves won't be affected.

Linux version will be updated ASAP.

Other fan-made translations are in progress, including Spanish. You can keep an eye on progress and testing of translation builds here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/364390/discussions/0/405692758710121138/

regards, Screen 7
& Harvester Games

notes.title: Update to ver 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Your copy of Downfall will now update to version 1.1.0 (build 1040340) ..

This version includes 3 additional languages, Russian, Italian & Brazil Portuguese. 

Save games from previous versions are compatible - however starting a new game with a language and loading an older save game (that was saved in English) will not currently load the language fonts.

Therefore, if playing with a language, we recommend starting a new game.

We may make another small update to this version to fix the above and to solve any minor issues with the translations. If you find any problems, please do let us know!

We will be updating DRM-free installers (GOG/Humble etc) to version 1.1.0 by the end of the week.

Update 24th March: Fixed issue with loading games in other languages & made final update to the Russian translation.

notes.title: Creepygrim Horror: Downfall Remake Released
notes.notes:
Say, how do you like horror adventure games full of love and death and murder and insanity and red blood splattered on black-and-white scenes? I ask because The Cat Lady developer Remigiusz Michalski has released a remake of his earlier point-and-cower game Downfall [official site]. It’s the tale of a man and his wife on a romantic getaway to rekindle their struggling marriage when things turn all dark and unpleasant and, I’d guess, possibly-all-in-your-head. It has a demo so you can see if it’s your bag.

… [visit site to read more]
